name: dellmatrix
description: DellMatrix — unified foundation + snap-ins (legacy DuoBeta under compat)

scripts.start: node -e "import { createUnifiedRuntime } from './src/unify.js'; const dm = createUnifiedRuntime(); console.log(JSON.stringify({ unified: dm.unified, era: dm.era, active: dm.listActive() }, null, 2));"
scripts.status: node -e "import { createUnifiedRuntime } from './src/unify.js'; const dm = createUnifiedRuntime(); console.log(JSON.stringify(dm.status(), null, 2));"
scripts.snapins: node -e "import { createUnifiedRuntime } from './src/unify.js'; const dm = createUnifiedRuntime(); console.log(dm.listSnapIns());"
scripts.unify: node -e "import { createUnifiedRuntime } from './src/unify.js'; import { describeUnification } from './src/compat/legacy_map.js'; const dm = createUnifiedRuntime(); console.log(describeUnification()); console.log('active', dm.listActive());"
